root.label: Judge authorizes natural gas vessel entry into San Juan Bay

events.label: Judge authorizes natural gas vessel entry into San Juan Bay

slots.name: vessel blockage duration
slots.sentence: Currently, those plants are using diesel — driving up costs — because a vessel laden with a delivery of natural gas was blocked from entering the San Juan Bay for two weeks given its size.

slots.name: vessel entry authorization
slots.sentence: The case went to court, and a judge on Thursday authorized its entry.
